notes: Stop names are the American Eclectic engraving. The Organ Type piston switches every stop to English Cathedral, French Romantic or German Baroque voices (Voice Palette); the Library/MIDI A/B controls are not included.
Four manuals: Choir (I), Great (II), Swell (III), Solo (IV).
MIDI channels are taken from the Infinity 243/361/484 owner's manual (no owner's manual for the 489 is published yet).
Grand Mixture IV-VIII: footage not published, 2' entered as a placeholder.
MIDI channels: the keyboards always transmit on fixed channels Great 12, Swell 13, Choir 15, Solo 16, Pedal 14, whether or not a Library/MIDI coupler is on. Check on your organ.

Individual stop messages are not published. Pistons send either a Rodgers "STOP MAP" System Exclusive dump or a memory Program Change (set in the MIDI menu). Neither can be mapped to single stops, so every stop is unbound: use Learn every stop. If a stop sends nothing when you move it, it cannot be learned.
The controller sent by the expression shoes is not documented, so no expression mapping is set.
Stop list: https://www.rodgersinstruments.com/organs/infinity-series/infinity-series-489 (Rodgers product page, Stoplist tab, American Eclectic)

MIDI scheme: https://www.rodgersinstruments.com/uploads/owners_manual/owners_guides_2017/1905371_H00_INFINITY_ORGAN.pdf (Rodgers Infinity 243/361/484 owner's manual, "About MIDI transmit channels", p. 18 / PDF p. 22: Choir CH15, Great CH12, Swell CH13, Solo CH16, Pedal CH14, fixed)
